title: Communication and nonquantum alternatives retain negative scoped outcomes
statement: The finite-flag product-Schur channel and analytic complex gradients were implemented and checked against full tensor n=1..4 calculations, primary symmetric-seed controls and finite differences. Searches at v=.38 and .4 found no positive coherent-information witness; negative, unconverged and interrupted runs are retained without a global no-go inference. A stronger pre-existing rectangular-GKP analog comparator already has I_c about .000111 at v=1/e+1e-5,r=3, so crossing hashing alone was an inadequate target. The largest n=12,B=3 engine used 1.828 GB, 1218 blocks, maximum block dimension 125 and 11–12 seconds per value/gradient. Charge 4096 receiver lookup cells but three output flags, finite energy, common packet and receiver costs. The explicit v=.38,r=3,64x64 three-flag lookup has I_c(1) about -.02169287. Interval-certified b-rho>0 in all three Clifford axes gives I_c(n)<=rho^n-b^n<0 for every length of EQUAL-MIXTURE repetition/GHZ input. Unequal mixtures and arbitrary codes are not excluded; a separate rational dual certifies that this same channel is NOT antidegradable. A non-repetition improvement remains unfound. The centered common packet's second-order half-diamond O(1/N) bound creates neither a positive witness nor an efficient encoder. The nonquantum selection pass earned no new capability: finite biaxial compression/inventory does not exclude a thin conducting path; SmNiO3 electronic leakage about 10^-5 S/cm fails the material gate, with compatibility/reset open. No new battery architecture, safety, capacity or priority claim.
